title: Smart Data Models - Petition, an extension of dataModel.CPSV-AP/Evidence
description: A petition filed with the publisher and how it was settled. Extends dataModel.CPSV-AP/Evidence: CPSV-AP Evidence is the official model of a document filed with a public body (identifier, name).
$comment: allOf: dataModel.CPSV-AP/Evidence's schema.json at commit a05d1663475fc0f79361bc9bc2550c3f24df1ba0 with its type set to Petition, then the attributes the extension adds (T-4336). Generated by scripts/open-data/generate.py.

type.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. It has to be Evidence

identifier.description: Property. Model:'dct:identifier'. This property represents an Identifier for the piece of Evidence

evidenceType.description: Property. Model:'dct:type'. This property represents the type of Evidence as described in a controlled vocabulary

relatedDocumentation.description: Property. Model: 'foaf:page'. This property represents documentation that contains information related to the Evidence, for instance a particular template for an administrative document, an application or a guide on formatting the Input

language.description: Property. Model:'dct:language'. This property represents the language(s) in which the Evidence is available. This could be one or multiple languages, for instance in countries with more than one official language. The possible values for this property are described in a controlled vocabulary. European Publications Office's Languages Named Authority List (NAL), http://publications.europa.eu/mdr/authority/language/index.html

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Petition

isPartOf.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. The catalogue dataset the row belongs to, where its licence and its other rows are.
